scope.flow: Router swap transaction execution without a user-specified deadline
scope.environment: Router contract and underlying Core contract on a decentralized exchange

statements.text: The Router contract does not allow users to specify a deadline for their swap transactions.
The Router provides slippage protection only via calculatedAmountThreshold and sqrtRatioLimit, which protect against price movements relative to execution time.
A transaction is held by a validator or remains in the mempool for an extended period.
The held transaction is executed after the delay when market conditions have changed unfavorably for the user.
The absence of a deadline parameter means nothing prevents execution of the swap after a significant delay.
Users may have their transactions executed at unexpected times.
Transactions executed at unexpected times can lead to unwanted trades or loss of opportunity for the user.
A swap transaction should not be executable after a user-specified deadline has passed.

ambiguities: Report does not state a concrete deadline value or a specific observed delayed execution; scenario is conditional.
Report does not establish that the validator/holder is adversarial beyond holding the transaction.
No specific amount, price, or loss magnitude is given for the unwanted trade or lost opportunity.
